presentation_summary: 40-year-old male presented to the emergency department with a diffuse body rash that had developed several weeks earlier.
Several weeks before the rash he had a group sexual encounter without barrier protection.
He recalled a prior painless penile shaft lesion before the rash developed.
Examination showed a diffuse maculopapular rash involving both palms and soles.
RPR was positive and he was treated with 2.4 million units of benzathine benzylpenicillin intramuscularly, then admitted for infectious disease consultation.
